name: 她的池中之物
overview: Gangster heiress Zhong Wangsheng becomes entangled with Lin Yubai, an art gallery owner who looks just like her murdered brother—unaware he’s actually an undercover cop. As Zhong Wangsheng and Lin Yubai are drawn together by revenge, secrets, and forbidden emotions, they're pulled into a dangerous game between love and betrayal.
